source_caption:
Billy Bob Thornton was originally offered Owen Davian but turned it down, opening the door for Philip Seymour Hoffman to create something far less conventional. In the interrogation scene, Hoffman avoids the theatrical rage expected from a blockbuster villain; his bored expression and almost casual threats make Davian feel like a man for whom cruelty is simply routine.

Mission: Impossible III (2006), directed by J.J. Abrams, starring Tom Cruise, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Michelle Monaghan. A ferocious spy thriller made unforgettable by a villain who never needs to raise his voice to control the room.

source_details.title: Mission: Impossible III
source_details.synopsis: Mission: Impossible III (abbreviated as M:i:III) is a 2006 American action spy film directed by J. J. Abrams (in his feature film directorial debut), and produced by and starring Tom Cruise, from a screenplay by Abrams and the writing team of Alex Kurtzman and Roberto Orci. It is a standalone sequel to Mission: Impossible (1996) and Mission: Impossible 2 (2000) and the third installment in the Mission: Impossible film series. It also stars Philip Seymour Hoffman, Ving Rhames, Billy Crudup, Michelle Monaghan, Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Keri Russell, Maggie Q, and Laurence Fishburne.
